## For Code PRs

> **AILANG uses an AI-first development model.** Code changes go through our
> automated pipeline: Issue → Design Doc → AI Sprint → Evaluation → Merge.
>
> **We will close this PR**, but your contribution is valued. Please:
> 1. Open an [issue](../../issues/new/choose) describing the change you want
> 2. The issue enters our triage pipeline automatically
> 3. Accepted issues become design docs, then AI-implemented sprints
> 4. You'll be credited in the changelog and design doc
>
> See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for why we work this way.

**If you believe this is an exception** (security fix, CI fix, etc.), explain why:
<!-- Why should this bypass the standard pipeline? -->
